import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

OUTPUT_PATH = "/tmp/pb_framework_v10.png"

# --- Global Plot Styles ---
plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'sans-serif'
plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'Nimbus Sans']
plt.rcParams['pdf.fonttype'] = 42
plt.rcParams['ps.fonttype'] = 42
plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 9
plt.rcParams['mathtext.fontset'] = 'cm'

# --- Figure Setup ---
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(14, 5.2), dpi=300, facecolor='white',
                          gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [1, 1.2, 1]})

for ax in axes:
    ax.axis('off')
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax.set_facecolor('white')

# --- Helper functions ---
def draw_box(ax, text, xy, width, height, facecolor, text_props=None, box_props=None, edgecolor='#BDBDBD'):
    if text_props is None:
        text_props = {'ha': 'center', 'va': 'center', 'fontsize': 9, 'color': '#212121'}
    if box_props is None:
        box_props = {'boxstyle': "round,pad=0.03", 'edgecolor': edgecolor, 'linewidth': 0.8}
    box = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        xy, width, height, facecolor=facecolor,
        transform=ax.transAxes, **box_props
    )
    ax.add_patch(box)
    ax.text(xy[0] + width / 2, xy[1] + height / 2, text,
            transform=ax.transAxes, **text_props)
    return box

def draw_arrow(ax, start_xy, end_xy, connectionstyle=None, color='#424242', lw=1.0):
    arrow = mpatches.FancyArrowPatch(
        start_xy, end_xy, transform=ax.transAxes,
        connectionstyle=connectionstyle,
        arrowstyle='->', color=color, linewidth=lw, mutation_scale=12
    )
    ax.add_patch(arrow)
    return arrow

# ============================================================
# Panel (a): Recursive Generation Chain
# ============================================================
ax_a = axes[0]
ax_a.set_title("(a) Recursive Generation Chain", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=10)

bw_a = 0.45
bh_a = 0.10
vs_a = 0.06
cx_a = 0.45  # center x (shifted slightly left to make room for recursive arrow)
sy_a = 0.88

# Boxes
box_gen0 = draw_box(ax_a, "gen-0\n(human seed)", (cx_a - bw_a/2, sy_a - bh_a), bw_a, bh_a, '#E8F5E9')
y_G = sy_a - bh_a - vs_a - bh_a
box_genG = draw_box(ax_a, "Generator G", (cx_a - bw_a/2, y_G), bw_a, bh_a, '#E3F2FD')
ax_a.text(cx_a, y_G - 0.03, "8 LLMs, 5 families", ha='center', va='top',
          fontsize=7, fontstyle='italic', color='#616161', transform=ax_a.transAxes)
y_1 = y_G - vs_a - bh_a - 0.02
box_gen1 = draw_box(ax_a, "gen-1", (cx_a - bw_a/2, y_1), bw_a, bh_a, '#FFF3E0')
y_2 = y_1 - vs_a - bh_a
box_gen2 = draw_box(ax_a, "gen-2+", (cx_a - bw_a/2, y_2), bw_a, bh_a, '#FFE0B2')

# Vertical arrows
draw_arrow(ax_a, (cx_a, sy_a - bh_a), (cx_a, y_G + bh_a))
draw_arrow(ax_a, (cx_a, y_G), (cx_a, y_1 + bh_a))
draw_arrow(ax_a, (cx_a, y_1), (cx_a, y_2 + bh_a))

# Recursive arrow: right side of gen-1 curves right and up to right side of Generator G
rx = cx_a + bw_a/2
draw_arrow(ax_a, (rx, y_1 + bh_a/2), (rx, y_G + bh_a/2),
           connectionstyle="arc3,rad=-0.5")
ax_a.text(rx + 0.08, (y_1 + y_G + bh_a) / 2, r"$x^{(k)}\!=\!G(x^{(k-1)})$",
          ha='left', va='center', fontsize=7, color='#424242', transform=ax_a.transAxes)

# Generator list at bottom
ax_a.text(cx_a, 0.06, "Py2.8 · Py1B · OLMo · Q1.7 · Q0.6 · Q8B · Llm3 · Mis7",
          ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=6.5, color='#757575', transform=ax_a.transAxes)


# ============================================================
# Panel (b): Feature Extraction
# ============================================================
ax_b = axes[1]
ax_b.set_title("(b) Feature Extraction", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=10)

bw_b = 0.55
bh_b = 0.08
vs_b = 0.045
sy_b = 0.92

# Top flow: Input → Pythia → NLL
box_input = draw_box(ax_b, r"Input text $x^{(k)}$", (0.5 - bw_b/2, sy_b - bh_b), bw_b, bh_b, '#F5F5F5')
y_py = sy_b - bh_b - vs_b - bh_b
box_pythia = draw_box(ax_b, "Pythia-410M\n(reference model)", (0.5 - bw_b/2, y_py), bw_b, bh_b + 0.02, '#F3E5F5')
y_nll = y_py - vs_b - bh_b - 0.02
box_nll = draw_box(ax_b, "Per-token NLL\ndistribution", (0.5 - bw_b/2, y_nll), bw_b, bh_b, '#FAFAFA')

draw_arrow(ax_b, (0.5, sy_b - bh_b), (0.5, y_py + bh_b + 0.02))
draw_arrow(ax_b, (0.5, y_py), (0.5, y_nll + bh_b))

# Three DDR zone boxes
sbw = 0.27  # small box width
sbh = 0.18  # small box height
gap = 0.025
y_zones = y_nll - vs_b - sbh - 0.01

# Positions
total_w = 3 * sbw + 2 * gap
x_drift = 0.5 - total_w / 2
x_inter = x_drift + sbw + gap
x_stat = x_inter + sbw + gap

# Draw zone boxes (background only, no text)
box_drift = draw_box(ax_b, "", (x_drift, y_zones), sbw, sbh, '#DCEEFB',
                     text_props={'ha': 'center', 'va': 'center', 'fontsize': 7.5, 'color': '#1565C0'})
box_inter = draw_box(ax_b, "", (x_inter, y_zones), sbw, sbh, '#FCE4EC',
                     text_props={'ha': 'center', 'va': 'center', 'fontsize': 7.5, 'color': '#8B4557'})
box_stat = draw_box(ax_b, "", (x_stat, y_zones), sbw, sbh, '#FFF8E1',
                     text_props={'ha': 'center', 'va': 'center', 'fontsize': 7.5, 'color': '#A67C00'})

# Zone headers (bold) and feature lists
for xc, label, items, color in [
    (x_drift, "Drifting", "entropy_mean\nTTR\nhapax_ratio", '#1565C0'),
    (x_inter, "Intermediate", "entropy_std", '#8B4557'),
    (x_stat, "Near-stationary", "entropy_max\nentropy_min\ntail_decay", '#A67C00'),
]:
    ax_b.text(xc + sbw/2, y_zones + sbh - 0.02, label, ha='center', va='top',
              fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color='#212121', transform=ax_b.transAxes)
    ax_b.text(xc + sbw/2, y_zones + sbh/2 - 0.01, items, ha='center', va='center',
              fontsize=7, color=color, transform=ax_b.transAxes, linespacing=1.3)

# Arrows from NLL to zone boxes
for xc in [x_drift + sbw/2, x_inter + sbw/2, x_stat + sbw/2]:
    draw_arrow(ax_b, (0.5, y_nll), (xc, y_zones + sbh))

# DDR features box at bottom
y_ddr = y_zones - vs_b - bh_b
box_ddr = draw_box(ax_b, "7 DDR features", (0.5 - bw_b/2, y_ddr), bw_b, bh_b, '#FFF8E1',
                   edgecolor='#D4A017')

# Arrows from zones to DDR
for xc in [x_drift + sbw/2, x_inter + sbw/2, x_stat + sbw/2]:
    draw_arrow(ax_b, (xc, y_zones), (0.5, y_ddr + bh_b))


# ============================================================
# Panel (c): LOGO Classification
# ============================================================
ax_c = axes[2]
ax_c.set_title("(c) LOGO Classification", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=10)

ax_c.text(0.5, 0.93, "Leave-One-Generator-Out", ha='center', va='top',
          fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='#424242', transform=ax_c.transAxes)

# Generator grid
gen_names = ["Py2.8", "Py1B", "OLMo", "Q1.7",
             "Q0.6", "Q8B", "Llm3", "Mis7"]
gen_colors = ['#C8E6C9']*5 + ['#FFCDD2'] + ['#C8E6C9']*2
gen_labels = ['train']*5 + ['test'] + ['train']*2

gbw = 0.19
gbh = 0.09
gh = 0.025  # horizontal gap
gv = 0.025  # vertical gap
total_gw = 4 * gbw + 3 * gh
gx0 = 0.5 - total_gw / 2
gy0 = 0.78  # top of grid

for i in range(2):
    for j in range(4):
        idx = i * 4 + j
        x = gx0 + j * (gbw + gh)
        y = gy0 - i * (gbh + gv)
        draw_box(ax_c, gen_names[idx], (x, y), gbw, gbh, gen_colors[idx],
                 text_props={'ha': 'center', 'va': 'center', 'fontsize': 8, 'color': '#212121'})

# Arrow from grid to classifier
grid_bottom_y = gy0 - gbh - gv - gbh  # bottom of second row

# Legend: train/test (positioned next to grid)
leg_y = grid_bottom_y - 0.04
ax_c.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch((0.12, leg_y), 0.06, 0.03, facecolor='#C8E6C9',
               edgecolor='#BDBDBD', linewidth=0.6, boxstyle="round,pad=0.01", transform=ax_c.transAxes))
ax_c.text(0.20, leg_y + 0.015, "train", fontsize=6.5, va='center', color='#424242', transform=ax_c.transAxes)
ax_c.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch((0.32, leg_y), 0.06, 0.03, facecolor='#FFCDD2',
               edgecolor='#BDBDBD', linewidth=0.6, boxstyle="round,pad=0.01", transform=ax_c.transAxes))
ax_c.text(0.40, leg_y + 0.015, "test", fontsize=6.5, va='center', color='#424242', transform=ax_c.transAxes)

clf_w = 0.45
clf_h = 0.10
clf_y = grid_bottom_y - 0.16
box_clf = draw_box(ax_c, "XGBoost\nClassifier", (0.5 - clf_w/2, clf_y), clf_w, clf_h, '#E3F2FD')
draw_arrow(ax_c, (0.5, grid_bottom_y), (0.5, clf_y + clf_h))

# Output boxes
ow = 0.20
oh = 0.08
og = 0.04
total_ow = 3 * ow + 2 * og
ox0 = 0.5 - total_ow / 2
oy = clf_y - 0.09

box_g0 = draw_box(ax_c, "gen-0", (ox0, oy), ow, oh, '#E8F5E9')
box_g1 = draw_box(ax_c, "gen-1", (ox0 + ow + og, oy), ow, oh, '#FFF3E0')
box_g2 = draw_box(ax_c, "gen-2+", (ox0 + 2*(ow + og), oy), ow, oh, '#FFE0B2')

# Arrows from classifier to output
for xc in [ox0 + ow/2, ox0 + ow + og + ow/2, ox0 + 2*(ow + og) + ow/2]:
    draw_arrow(ax_c, (0.5, clf_y), (xc, oy + oh))

ax_c.text(0.5, oy - 0.03, "depth prediction", ha='center', va='top',
          fontsize=8, fontstyle='italic', color='#616161', transform=ax_c.transAxes)


# --- Save ---
fig.tight_layout(pad=1.0)
plt.savefig(OUTPUT_PATH, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
pdf_path = OUTPUT_PATH.replace('.png', '.pdf')
plt.savefig(pdf_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')

print(f"Saved to {OUTPUT_PATH} and {pdf_path}")
